title: Text model routing changed
summary:
Text model routing changed, token limits became hard caps, and a Portuguese-language image generator joined Creative Projects.

`openai-large` now resolves to GPT-5 Nano. GPT-4.1 and its `gpt-4.1` alias were removed from the available models list, while `openai-fast` remains on GPT-4.1 Nano. Requests also gained backend-model-ID aliases for Mistral Small 3.1 24B and DeepSeek R1 0528.

Text requests now respect each model’s configured `max_tokens` limit rather than allowing a higher requested value to override it. Requests below the cap keep their chosen limit; requests without one use the configured limit.

CapyUniverse – CapyIMG was added to Creative Projects. Its browser interface lets people set a prompt, exclusions, image size, aspect ratio, and a count of one to four images.
